title: Flow cytometric characterization of tissue-resident lymphocytes after murine liver and heart transplantation
protocol: Induce anesthesia and place the mouse in a supine position with continuous anesthetic delivery.
Secure the limbs with tape to provide access to the abdomen.
Sterilize the abdomen with 70% ethanol.
Open the mouse: With forceps, lift the skin at the pelvis and make an incision with scissors.
Continue the incision to the sternum, exposing the peritoneal cavity membrane.
Carefully cut open the peritoneum from the pelvis to the sternum.
Further open the abdomen by incising along the flanks.
Move the abdominal organs aside with cotton tip applicators to expose the transplanted organ.
Locate and incompletely sever the inferior vena cava (IVC) at the top of the liver.
Perfuse the liver with 10 mL cold saline by inserting a 23 G needle attached to a 10 mL syringe into the IVC.
Remove and discard the gallbladder.
Resect the liver, taking care to cut any adhesions to the surrounding tissue.
Place the resected liver in DMEM and keep on ice.
Perfuse the mouse by injecting 3 mL cold saline into the abdominal aorta using a 30 G needle below the heart graft.
Cut the aorta and soak up the perfusate with a cotton ball.
Resect the heart graft from the abdomen, place in DMEM and keep on ice.
Cut both lateral sides of the rib cage and the diaphragm.
Clamp the sternum with clamp forceps and invert to expose the chest cavity.
Isolate and resect the heart from the chest cavity, place in DMEM and keep on ice.
Record the weight of liver tissue to be used for flow cytometry if taking a section for histology.
Place the liver into a 70 μm cell strainer atop a 50 mL tube.
Mash the liver through the strainer with the rubber end of a 3 mL syringe plunger, rinsing with FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g with swinging buckets for 3 min at 21°C–23°C then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL 42% isotonic Percoll and transfer to a 15 mL tube.
Wash the original tube with 4 mL 42% isotonic Percoll and combine in the 15 mL tube.
Ensure Percoll is at 21°C–23°C before use.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 20 min at 21°C–23°C with no brake to separate hepatocytes (top cellular layer) and leukocytes (pellet).
Ensure brake is off during centrifugation.
Remove and discard the top cellular layer and Percoll from the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of RBC Lysis buffer.
Transfer to a new 15 mL tube containing 4.8 mL of RBC Lysis buffer.
Wash the bottom of the original 15 mL tube with another 100 μL of RBC Lysis buffer.
Combine wash in the new 15 mL tube and mix well.
Incubate for 5 min at 21°C–23°C with occasional shaking.
Add 5 mL FACS buffer and centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C to re-pellet the leukocytes.
Resuspend the pellet in 400 μL of FACS buffer.
Record the weight of heart tissue.
Transfer the heart to a 60 mm petri dish.
Rinse the heart with PBS.
Dissect the heart in half lengthways.
Rinse the dissected heart again with PBS.
Transfer the rinsed heart to a clean 60 mm petri dish.
Inject 500 μL of the heart digestion cocktail into the tissue.
Inject at multiple points to disperse the cocktail evenly throughout the tissue.
Decant the remaining 4.5 mL of the digestion cocktail into the petri dish with the heart.
Incubate for 10 min at 37°C with gentle shaking at 80 rpm.
Remove the heart from the digestion cocktail.
Mince the heart tissue until pieces are approximately 0.5–1 mm³ in size using a scalpel.
Resuspend the minced heart tissue in the digestion cocktail.
Transfer the resuspended tissue to a 50 mL tube.
Incubate for 30 min at 37°C with shaking at 150 rpm.
Pass the mixture through a 70 μm strainer, mashing any remaining clumps gently through with the rubber end of a 3 mL syringe plunger.
Rinse the cell strainer with 10 mL DMEM with 15% HI-NCS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C to pellet cells.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL 42% isotonic Percoll.
Transfer the resuspended pellet to a new 15 mL tube.
Wash the tube with an additional 4 mL 42% isotonic Percoll.
Combine the wash solution with the resuspended pellet in the new tube.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 20 min at 21°C–23°C with no brake.
Ensure brake is off during centrifugation.
Carefully remove and discard the top cellular layer and supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 μL RBC lysis buffer.
Transfer resuspended pellet to a new 15 mL tube containing 900 μL RBC lysis buffer.
Rinse the bottom of the original tube with an additional 100 μL RBC lysis buffer and transfer to the new tube.
Incubate at 21°C–23°C for 2 minutes until red blood cells are lysed.
Add 5 mL FACS buffer to the tube containing the lysed pellet.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 minutes at 21°C–23°C to re-pellet the leukocytes.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Count cells using 5-10 μL of cell suspension.
Transfer 0.1–4 × 10^6 cells per well to a 96 well U bottom plate.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 200 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Flick the plate firmly over a waste receptacle to discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in unstimulated wells with 200 μL DMEM with 10% HI-NCS.
In stimulated wells, resuspend the cells in 200 μL Cell Activation Cocktail diluted 1:500 in DMEM with 10% HI-NCS.
Incubate for 4 h at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 200 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Continue with the ‘staining for flow cytometry’ step below using a panel such as that detailed in Table 2.
Transfer 0.1–4 × 10^6 cells per well for staining.
Perform staining in 96 well U-bottom plates or Eppendorf/FACS tubes.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 200 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 150 μL PBS.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 40 μL Zombie UV solution diluted 1:1000 in PBS.
Incubate for 20 min at 21°C–23°C in the dark.
Wash the cells with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 200 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 40 μL surface antibody cocktail as per Tables 2 or 3.
Incubate cells for 20 min at 21°C–23°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 200 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL Fixation/Permeabilization buffer.
Incubate cells for 10 min at 21°C–23°C in the dark.
Add 100 μL Permeabilization buffer and mix well.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 800 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 150 μL Permeabilization buffer.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Add 20 μL intracellular antibody cocktail and incubate for 20 min at 21°C–23°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 150 μL Permeabilization buffer.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells once more with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL 1× BD Stabilizing Fixative.
Incubate for 15 min at 21°C–23°C in the dark.
Add 150 μL FACS buffer.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 500 × g for 3 min at 21°C–23°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 150 μL FACS buffer.
Cells are now ready for analysis on a flow cytometer.
